title: Piaget's sensorimotor stage runs from birth to about age two
summary: OpenStax says Piaget's sensorimotor stage lasts from birth to about two years, with learning through the senses and movement.
body: OpenStax Psychology calls Piaget's first stage of cognitive development the sensorimotor stage. It lasts from birth to about two years old. In it, children learn about the world through their senses and through motor behavior. The ages are the bands the textbook prints for his theory. They are not a clinical threshold. The ages are the textbook's spans for his theory and not a clinical threshold.

sources.title: OpenStax Psychology, 9.2 Lifespan Theories
